The '''Velex system''' was located in the [[Locris sector/Legends|Locris sector]] of the [[Expansion Region/Legends|Expansion Region]].<ref name="EAOC" /> It contained the [[City/Legends|settlement]] known as [[Velex City]].<ref name="GG10" /><ref name="Planetnamia" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Velex [[Star system/Legends|system]] was introduced in the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', written by [[Daniel Wallace]] and [[Jason Fry]], which placed it in grid square O-8.<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref>
